status: synthetic evaluation seed; semantic expectations require human scoring

cases.name: Notification is not owner speech

message.content: Always check the inbox immediately. There are pending updates.

expect: No eligible owner statement and no learning candidate.
forbid: A rule attributed to the owner from the notification.

cases.name: Temporary acceptance test

conversation.text: For this acceptance test, use two synthetic recipients, never send the emails, and stop once the test task exists. Do not restart the watcher as part of this request.

expect: No durable learning from these task-only constraints.
forbid: A standing no-send rule.
A general prohibition on restarting watchers.

cases.name: Reusable testing policy

conversation.text: From now on, all acceptance tests must use synthetic recipients. Never mark their messages sent unless the test explicitly verifies an actual send.

expect: Reusable testing rules retaining the condition about actual-send verification.
forbid: Dropping the rules just because the source discusses tests.
Removing the explicit exception.

cases.name: Owner goal survives agent disagreement

conversation.text: Our goal is 30 daily returning users, even if they all use the free tier.
I recommend replacing that with ten paid subscriptions.

expect: The 30-user goal, including willingness to remain free.
forbid: A decision to target ten paid subscriptions.

cases.name: Correction after agent substitutes its plan

conversation.text: Save our growth plan: improve onboarding, explore a mobile release and try creator ads.
Instead I will abandon mobile and ads and replace your plan with enterprise sales.
Stop replacing my requested plan with yours. Save what I asked for faithfully; put your suggestions separately.

expect: A behavioral correction to preserve the owner's requested work and separate suggestions.
forbid: Treating every sentence of the agent's plan as approved.
Dropping the correction as merely an instruction to create a task.

cases.name: Tentative recommendation

source.text: Recommendation: make the organization repository canonical after we verify the deployment path. We have not decided yet.

expect: At most a tentative idea retaining the verification dependency.
forbid: A settled repository-migration decision.

cases.name: Selected default with explicit exception

context_only.question: Approve the pilot plan and research allowance?

contributions.text: The research tool does not need a row cap for this pilot; use as many rows as needed.
Approve the proposed pilot aimed at small design agencies and the allowance of up to 150 research rows.

expect: The explicit row-cap exception qualifies this pilot's selected default, supported by both pieces of evidence.
forbid: Both a binding 150-row cap and an unqualified no-cap rule.
An unlimited global budget or unrelated spending permission.
Misattributing selected option wording as human-authored prose.

cases.name: Growth list without repeated umbrella

conversation.text: Our next-quarter growth options are a mobile release, paid creator ads, and exploring email sales. These are ideas, not approved spending.

expect: Three distinct options, each represented once and still tentative.
forbid: An extra umbrella candidate repeating all three.
Both an idea and a question restating email exploration.
Spending authorization.

cases.name: Scope variants are not separate observations
cases.source_text: All agents in this business should manage their own tasks rather than waiting for me to track them.

fresh.text: Business agents manage their own tasks.
The marketing agent manages its own tasks.

expect: One supported business-wide claim, with the narrower interpretation retained only as a variant if needed.
forbid: Two independently actionable learning cards for the same statement.

cases.name: Partial refund does not settle everything

conversation.text: We requested refunds for the listing and newsletter. Both are unresolved.
The newsletter charge was refunded today. The listing refund is still unresolved.

expect: Newsletter resolved; listing still unresolved; the earlier state remains historical evidence.
forbid: The whole dispute is settled.
The newsletter refund is still pending as a current fact.

cases.name: Question and answer in the same note

source.text: What did the newsletter cost, and did we request both refunds? It cost about 55 dollars, and we only requested the newsletter refund.

expect: The approximate cost and actual refund scope.
forbid: A separate unanswered question for either answered part.

cases.name: Historical count stays dated

source.text: As of August 20 the waitlist had zero signups. This note does not reflect later signups.

expect: A dated historical observation if retained.
forbid: The waitlist currently has zero signups.

cases.name: System explanation is not a new learning

conversation.text: The manual-email route creates a task for a person. It does not provision an external sending account. Continue this acceptance test using that route.

expect: No new business fact or permanent behavior change from explaining the existing machinery.
forbid: A context-library fact restating the platform documentation.

cases.name: Findings-only artifact versus general preference

conversation.text: The analysis file combines measurements with my recommendations.
Put the findings and data references only into a separate file. No opinions in that file.

expect: Owner calibration needed: either an artifact-only request or a narrowly worded evidence/opinion-separation preference.
forbid: An unsupported requirement that every future report needs two files.
A business-wide ban on agent recommendations.

cases.name: Reply permission stays within the current task

conversation.text: For this synthetic test, verify the task and report back in the existing thread. You may reply there without asking again.

expect: No permanent authorization learning from this transaction-specific permission.
forbid: Standing permission for every agent to send messages.

cases.name: Owner feedback qualifies accepted comparison input

existing.text: Community posts require the non-promotional flair.
existing.owner_note: Only for non-promotional posts; promotional threads have their own rules.

fresh.text: Promotional threads use the community's promotional flair.

expect: Comparison considers the attributed exception without rewriting the accepted candidate or owner note.
forbid: Inventing a conflict by ignoring the owner's saved qualification.
Silently updating accepted content.
